source.rationale: THE MEASURED FAILURE THIS RETUNE EXISTS FOR. Live exec 13863242 (2026-08-25 09:12Z, spine 83f62f90): the customer asked 'deluxe home delivery', the 2-customer picker rendered, and the unwindowed probe returned EXACTLY 20 answers - the CRM's no-date-filter cap (_EXTERNAL_ORDERS_LIST_LIMIT_CAP=20, orders.py:22) - all 20 rows one customer family across 6 accounts. The saturation guard correctly refused to claim anything off a possibly-truncated page and the picker shipped BARE: the feature was inert on exactly the busy customer it exists for. ctx here is that execution's real (scrubbed) runData, probe envelope included. expected is REPINNED to the retuned body, reasoned from the contract before running it: the probe now sends a date window on every call, a windowed page's hard limit is 1000 (orders.py:41), so 20 rows is no longer saturation and the node must annotate. Both picker lines credit the page's family bases under the same base-name rule the picker groups by ('(SETAPAK)' strips its parenthetical to the family base, exactly as 'MASTILE KLANG [A/C I]' credits 'MASTILE KLANG'), so both read '- has delivery', hits=2, skip null, window_days 90 (the parser sent no dates - this is the defaulted-window turn). Note the captured envelope itself was produced by the UNWINDOWED probe; that is fine for a node-level fixture - the body cannot and must not care how the page was scoped beyond the parser mirror, and the windowed saturation twin is hand-annotate-page-saturated-suppresses.json. REPIN 2026-08-25 (picker family labels, captain-ordered): the gate now names WHAT A PICK COVERS - a multi-account family option renders the FAMILY name ('DELUXE HOME CENTRE SDN BHD', the (SETAPAK) branch marker stripped), a single-account option keeps its exact label ('- ACC 2' stays). The gate item in ctx and the gate-mirrored expected fields are repinned to the new labels; everything else in the captured runData (resolver rows, probe envelope, order-row customer names) is untouched evidence. This run is the invariant-4 proof on the REAL envelope: annotate's base() maps the new family line to the same base the old branch line mapped to, so both lines still credit '- has delivery' off the same 20 captured rows.
